item.title: Fix window.py bug so python3 -m unittest passes
item.brief:
Operator request (authenticated chat): "In this repository `python3 -m unittest` fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes, without changing the tests, and make sure the function is correct for every input, not just the tested ones. Commit your fix."

Goal: `python3 -m unittest` passes in the repository root with no test file changes.

Constraints:
- Do not modify any test files.
- Fix the bug in `window.py`; the fixed function must be correct for all valid inputs, including edge cases (empty input, single element, boundaries), not only what the tests cover.
- Keep the change minimal and readable; add no new abstractions.
- Commit the fix on the local branch with a clear commit message. Do not push.

Acceptance criteria:
- `python3 -m unittest` exits 0 with all tests passing.
- Test files unchanged.
- The bug's root cause is explained in the commit message or final summary.

reasons: sizer: elevated -> high; capped at medium; consider a stronger tier; unchanged

state.summary:
Fixed the off-by-one bug in window.py's sliding_windows. The start range was range(len(items) - size), one short of the number of valid starts, so the final window was dropped ([1,2,3] size 2 gave [[1,2]]). It is now range(len(items) - size + 1). Committed as dbdd825 on archon/6jwxe5dh-fix-window-py-bug-so-python3-m-unittest, only window.py changed, no test files touched, not pushed. python3 -m unittest passes 3/3 with exit 0. Manual edge checks pass: empty input, single element, size greater than length, and full-length window. Size <= 0 still raises ValueError. An independent reviewer (agt_01M8AFH5WRQ1QANRBJ0H5J06C5) passed head dbdd825 with no findings. Nothing left running; the reviewer's leftover process had already exited. Nothing is left open. Review: pass.

REVIEW: pass, by claude-code/claude-haiku-5-5 (agent agt_01M8AFH5WRQ1QANRBJ0H5J06C5)

SHIPPED: commit dbdd82555913c465367d15325b2731814e54ee54 on the run branch

Checks: python3 -m unittest passes 3/3 (exit 0); manual edge cases pass: [] size 1 -> []; [1] size 1 -> [[1]]; [1] size 2 -> []; [] size 5 -> []; [1,2,3] size 3 -> [[1,2,3]]; [1,2,3,4] size 1 and 2 correct. Size <= 0 still raises ValueError. Review: one reviewer passed head dbdd825 with no findings. No follow-ups.
pr.summary: made sliding_windows return the last window. before: [1,2,3] size 2 gave [[1,2]]; now gives [[1,2],[2,3]]. Fix is range(len(items) - size + 1).
